commit.message:
fix(browser): successor qualification liveness — bounded re-probe, pending-prior tolerance, stale capsule reconcile

Repairs the structural deadlock observed on the live host (13.5h stuck in
TARGET_INSTALLED_PENDING_QUALIFICATION / SUCCESSOR_BOOTED):

1. Qualification re-probe loop (main-entry wiring + module): the one-shot
   30s startup window is no longer the only attempt. The same fail-closed
   probe predicate re-runs on a bounded reconciliation interval while the
   recovery diagnostic reports TARGET_INSTALLED_PENDING_QUALIFICATION; stops
   on any terminal state; no installer effect, no authority.
2. Signed-heartbeat updater-health tolerance: updater ERROR with exactly
   self_update_transaction_unresolved_prior:SUCCESSOR_BOOTED is the pending
   qualification itself, not unhealthiness — previously this self-referential
   error permanently blocked the heartbeat the qualification needed.
3. Signed-heartbeat continuity NONE acceptance: a restarted successor whose
   capsule was already cleared has nothing to restore; NONE is a settled
   state (the probe still independently verifies capsule absence on disk).
   TARGET_VERSION_MISMATCH with a strictly-older capsule target is treated
   as a stale leftover instead of a hard quarantine; newer/equal targets
   still quarantine fail-closed.
4. Stale capsule supersede-reconcile: strictly-older session-continuity
   capsules are archived to a superseded sidecar (durable rename, never
   deleted) by the watchdog mismatch branch and by the re-probe loop;
   future-target and non-comparable capsules stay fail-closed.
5. Updater self-poisoning guard: #launchInstaller holds the next install
   (READY_RESTART, no error, pending_prior_qualification=true) while the
   prior transaction is SUCCESSOR_BOOTED for the currently running version,
   instead of latching the sticky unresolved_prior ERROR.
6. D1 watchdog cancel-race fix: both continuity and old-parent-handoff
   watchdogs honor cancellation at await points before effectful tails
   (relaunch/exit); durable writes remain auditable.
7. Result transport bounded redelivery: command receipts are immutable and
   the completion RPC is idempotent per command_id — a transient 5xx now
   gets one bounded redelivery instead of dropping the receipt into
   lease_timeout_no_retry; 4xx still surfaces immediately; browser effects
   are never re-executed.

Tested: 13 new contract tests + full self-update battery (161) + native
supervisor/sentinel battery (236), zero failures.
